transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I need help making them stop. There are people following me and monitoring everything I do, and I'm really worried they are trying to harm me. I just don't feel safe anymore.

Have there been times when you felt unusually high, energized, or needed very little sleep, or times when you felt very depressed for days or weeks? If so, did the feeling of being followed happen only during those mood periods or also when your mood felt normal?

No, I haven't really experienced those kinds of extreme highs or lows with my mood. Aside from the constant stress and anxiety of being watched, my mood has been relatively normal. This monitoring happens all the time, not just in phases.

Besides feeling followed, have you heard voices when no one is there or had trouble organizing your thoughts or daily activities? Have other people noticed you acting oddly or becoming less able to work or take care of yourself?

No, I definitely don't hear any voices, and my mind is completely clear and organized. I am fully capable of working, taking care of myself, and managing my daily life without any issues. The only problem I have is the fact that these people are constantly following and monitoring me.
How long have you been feeling that people are following and monitoring you? Has this been going on for at least one month?

Yes, it has been going on for much longer than just a month. I have been dealing with this constant monitoring and being followed for about a year and ten months now. It is really exhausting to live with this worry for so long.
Since this started, have you had a clear decline in work, relationships, or self-care because of it, or have you mostly continued functioning about the same aside from dealing with this belief?

Aside from the stress of dealing with this constant monitoring, my life has remained pretty much the same. I still go to work every day, maintain my relationships, and take care of my home without any issues. My overall ability to function hasn't declined, it's just the ongoing worry about what they are planning that is exhausting.
